Five steps: Source (GitHub repo, VPS repo in `/srv/git`, a folder on the console server inside the allowed roots, or a new AXF app from a template + boilerplate; each with a Browse li

commits.message: Add the project wizard console plugin: turn a repo, folder or new AXF app into a Claude project with GitHub, VPS and local homes and a Claude.ai project kit
Harden the project wizard and claude-project: no writes through symlinks, safer folder sources, only their own files committed
Plugin settings are sub-tabs of Settings → Plugins, never top-level tabs
